title: Strengthen autonomy active liveness evidence
summary: Extend the backend-owned autonomy worker health payload with detection-only active liveness watchdog evidence.
reason: The 30-day hardening phase needs stronger ActiveJobs liveness evidence before any future active watchdog mutation is considered. This slice must remain read-only and must not kill processes or rewrite state.
behavior_before: Autonomy worker health only aged ActiveJobs records with fixed review/block thresholds and did not expose the liveness evidence or configured timeout basis used for the decision.
behavior_after: Autonomy worker health reports read-only watchdog evidence that combines ActiveJobs heartbeat, progress/event/log freshness, and configured native timeout budgets before gating new launches.
